title: Grilled Lamb Satay
description: A traditional British dish with a twist, featuring marinated grilled lamb served with a side of aromatic peanut sauce.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine coconut milk, peanut butter, honey, soy sauce, ginger, and garlic. Blend until smooth.
Grill the lamb shoulder to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C) for medium-rare.
Let the lamb rest for 5 minutes before slicing it into thin strips.
In a pan over medium heat, toast the peanuts until fragrant.
Add the peanut sauce to the pan and stir to combine with the peanuts.
Add the sliced lamb to the pan and toss to coat with the peanut sauce.
Serve the lamb satay with additional peanut sauce for dipping.
Garnish with toasted peanuts and a sprinkle of lime juice.
